in_marathi.name: Harshavardhan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harshavardhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harshavardhan is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Harsh (Lord) and Vardhan (Nourisher). The name signifies the one who nourishes and protects the gods and the devotees.

in_bengali.name: Harshavardhan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Gods

vedic_reference.root_origin: Vardhan is a form of Lord Vishnu
vedic_reference.note: Harshavardhan is a revered name in Hinduism, derived from Lord Vishnu's form Vardhan. He is often depicted with a conch shell and a mace in his hands, symbolizing the power to bestow joy and protect his devotees.
